items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop All Over Print Duffel Bag
items.alt: Navy duffel bag printed edge to edge with large white sailboats on teal waves, carried over one shoulder on a Wrightsville Beach dune path, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed duffel with a navy sloop pattern running edge to edge across the body and both ends. A Wrightsville Beach weekend bag for the Carolina coast.
facts: Small or Large, see the size chart image
Black, adjustable, with a shoulder pad
Sailboat pattern printed edge to edge on the body and both end panels, not embroidered
